Try a quick challenge

Just a quick try. Not saved; no game rewards.

ExploreCalendars

If the day before yesterday was Thursday, what day will it be 11 days from today?

  1. AMonday
  2. BTuesday
  3. CThursday
  4. DWednesday

Choose an answer.

Need a hint?

Work out what day today is first. Then use the remainder after dividing by 7.

Answer & method
Answer D: Wednesday

Today is Saturday. 11 ÷ 7 leaves 4, so going forward 4 days gives Wednesday.

ReasonNumber patterns

Find the next number in the series: 19, 25, 31, 37, 43, ?

  1. A48
  2. B86
  3. C49
  4. D50

Choose an answer.

Need a hint?

Look at the gaps or the ratio between neighbouring numbers.

Answer & method
Answer C: 49

The rule is add 6 each time. After 43 comes 49.

StretchCoding and decoding

In a code, MOUSE is written as SMUEO. How is BRICK written in that code?

  1. AKCIRB
  2. BRICKB
  3. CRKIBC
  4. DCBIKR

Choose an answer.

Need a hint?

Find where each letter of the first word moved, then move the second word the same way.

Answer & method
Answer D: CBIKR

Positions 4, 1, 3, 5, 2 of MOUSE give SMUEO. The same positions of BRICK give CBIKR.

For grown-ups

Ideas to practise

  • Coding and decoding. Apply the stated code consistently to each letter.
  • Repeating patterns. Find the smallest repeating group and continue that group.
  • Direction sense. Track north/south and east/west movements separately.
  • Position and order. Use the given left-to-right order, then count or locate a neighbour.
  • Ranking and order. Include the person being counted when converting a rank from one end to the other.
  • Calendars. Read the weekday headings. A week has seven days; count intervals, not both endpoints.
  • Number patterns. Look for the same change between neighbouring numbers.
  • Reflection and symmetry. A mirror reverses left and right, but not top and bottom.
  • Comparing quantities. Compare the values, not the size or spacing of their pictures.

A game mission has 8 untimed questions. Only the game saves choices and hints. A finished mission earns one launch charge and participation towards the Right power wing in Nebula Research Station. The chapter goal is 8 different questions in finished sets; hints and wrong answers count as participation, not mastery. Some craft systems link more than one chapter.

Using the feedback

Learning reports distinguish hinted answers from independent first choices. They consider up to 20 recent different, unhinted questions per skill and level, and wait for at least five before suggesting extra practice. Repeating the same question does not add evidence. Reports are practice evidence, not IQ scores, diagnoses, ranks or predictions of competition results.

Ask the learner to explain a drawing or check with objects too. Choose Explore or an earlier chapter when a step feels too large.

Sources & limits

The grade topics use SOF IMO Class 4 published topic syllabus as their primary reference. The SOF sample and CREST previous-year paper below informed representations and reasoning demands. Providers have different topic boundaries; their syllabi are not interchangeable.

  • Sample, not an administered paper: SOF IMO Class 4 sample, 2026-27
  • Previous-year paper: CREST CMO Class 4 previous-year paper, 2023-24 Set A

Questions, diagrams, picture choices, hints and explanations are original Otterly work, not copied paper questions or publisher artwork. No Olympiad provider is affiliated with or endorses Space Academy. This is not complete exam preparation; follow classroom teaching and check the current official syllabus too. Independent educator review is still needed for difficulty and breadth.

Content and coverage notes. To report a confusing question, describe the grade, chapter, level and question on the contact page. Do not send children’s personal information.
